name: strata-mod
description: A terminal document view for StrataSpace in Claude Code. A pane opens beside the chat when Claude reads a document, a band above the prompt tracks what Claude has read and when it changed, an explorer and review queue (/strata) search your Spaces and list the suggestions and comments made this session, @strata: mentions complete to a document in the prompt, and with the strata CLI the pane follows the document live with collaborators' presence. Works on its own or beside the strata plugin.

cliPath.title: strata CLI
cliPath.description: The strata CLI the live watch runs (`strata doc watch`): a path, or a name on PATH.

liveWatch.title: Live watch
liveWatch.description: Follow the pane's document live through the CLI when it is signed in; off, the pane polls revisions over MCP.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane on read
autoOpen.description: Open the document pane unasked the first time Claude reads a Strata document in a wide enough terminal.
